name: South Korea
shortSummary: India and South Korea maintain a Special Strategic Partnership underpinned by large Korean industrial investment — Samsung, Hyundai and LG operate major Indian manufacturing bases — and a bilateral trade agreement in force since 2010.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Samsung, Hyundai, Kia and LG operate major manufacturing and R&D facilities in India.
Growing cooperation on shipbuilding technology transfer.

majorChallenges.title: Trade imbalance
majorChallenges.description: India runs a persistent trade deficit with South Korea, concentrated in electronics and machinery.

recentDevelopments.title: Talks on upgrading the CEPA trade agreement continue
recentDevelopments.description: India and South Korea continued discussions on modernizing their 2010 trade agreement to expand coverage.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reflects steady, unspectacular progress in one of India's most commercially significant East Asian partnerships.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and South Korea formally establish diplomatic relations.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
historicalEvents.description: A bilateral trade agreement comes into force, phasing down tariffs across a wide range of goods and services.

historicalEvents.title: Special Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: Ties are upgraded during President Park Geun-hye's visit to India.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.description: Bilateral trade agreement now under review for an upgrade to expand coverage.

trade.majorExports: Petroleum products, iron and steel, marine products
